question: Does the s064 Jacobi-coord (polhode-basis) LM polish surface additional Band A clusters from the same s059j cluster reps on post-fix seed 89, beyond vanilla full-LC polish?
hypothesis: Polhode-basis LM polish is a drop-in replacement that finds additional Band A clusters from the same cluster reps (the s064 architectural claim).
narrative_md: Re-ran s064 Jacobi-coord polish on the shared post-fix seed-89 s059j output. It lands the same single Band A cluster (id=457) as vanilla full-LC polish (s069) — 1/50 unique, vs pre-fix 5/50 — surfacing no extra cluster. The s064 'finds additional Band A clusters' claim is empirically refuted on this replication; the speedup claim and truth-invariance smoke still hold. Truth basin at rank 1987 is outside the top-50 budget regardless of parameterisation.
